items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber removed from the damaged garden building
items.rationale: Disposal of damaged building components from insured garden building is covered and necessary.

items.description: Disposal of the broken glass pane from the damaged shed
items.rationale: Disposal of broken glazing from insured garden building is covered and necessary.

items.description: Disposal of green waste from the storm-felled tree (branches and foliage)
items.rationale: Clearance of storm-felled tree debris is covered as material arising, but vegetation removal is generally excluded except for clearance.

items.description: Disposal of the tree root ball (single mass under one cubic metre)
items.rationale: Removal of root mass under one cubic metre caused by insured event is covered and necessary.

items.description: Disposal of sieved topsoil from the churned-up ground
items.rationale: Ground material disposal is not covered under policy even if churned up by insured event.

items.description: Disposal of paving grit displaced around the shed
items.rationale: Ground material disposal is excluded from coverage.

items.description: Disposal of excavated soil from the churned-up ground
items.rationale: Ground material disposal is excluded from coverage.
